FACT_ID: sec09-F01 | anchor: A01
Impaired driving touches over forty percent of state motor-vehicle deaths behind thousands of cut-short lives injuries and shattered families, every impaired driver endangers the road, under-twenty-one drivers form four percent of drivers yet seven percent of impaired fatal-crash drivers which toughens youth revocation, and penalties run severe with likely capture and tight plea-bargain curbs. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=54]

FACT_ID: sec09-F02 | anchor: A01
Alcohol slows reactions dims vision warps speed and distance sense loosens inhibition and invites chances, turns night driving deadlier through glare blindness, acts from the first drink before any drunk look or feel, breeds false confidence about fitness, and corrupts the hundreds of per-mile decisions that keep cars controlled as the stop-sign gamble shows. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=54]

FACT_ID: sec09-F03 | anchor: A01
Driving impaired by drugs alcohol or their mix including marijuana cannabis cocaine LSD heroin opium and some prescriptions is criminal, degrades reflexes judgment vision and alertness with further dangers, and combined doses severely wreck driving plus health up to death. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=54]

FACT_ID: sec09-F04 | anchor: A02
Arrestable offenses span aggravated driving while intoxicated, driving while intoxicated, point-zero-eight-plus blood alcohol, drug impairment, alcohol impairment, and combined influence, with blood alcohol measured in breath blood urine or saliva counting over point-zero-five as impairment evidence, point-zero-eight-plus as intoxication, and point-one-eight-plus as aggravated. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=55]

FACT_ID: sec09-F05 | anchor: A02
Officer testimony on driving appearance and behavior can convict without any chemical test, guilty verdicts force license revocation or suspension at sentencing with the license seized at once despite any twenty-day driving grace, and commercial drivers face still tougher standards detailed in the commercial manual. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=55]

FACT_ID: sec09-F06 | anchor: A02
Blood alcohol tracks drink count spacing and body weight rather than beverage kind fitness or tolerance, equal alcohol rides in one-and-one-half ounces of liquor five ounces of wine twelve ounces of beer and twelve ounces of cooler with none safer, and each drink lifts a one-hundred-fifty-pound man about point-zero-two cleared in roughly an hour while women process slower longer and higher. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=55]

FACT_ID: sec09-F07 | anchor: A03
Weight shifts blood alcohol yet nobody holds immunity since more drink per hour means higher content and worse driving, a few drinks reach illegality with effects from the first, food merely slows absorption, and only passing time sobers because coffee exercise and cold showers just fight sleep. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=56]

FACT_ID: sec09-F08 | anchor: A03
Blood breath urine or saliva tests follow arrest under implied consent granted by driving itself, while refusal stands apart with suspension at arraignment admissibility at trial and revocation after a confirming hearing even behind acquittal, with refusal penalties detailed in chapter two. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=56]

FACT_ID: sec09-F09 | anchor: A03
Conviction brings the tabulated fines surcharges license hits and jail plus wider fallout, and repeaters face lifetime reinstatement review with permanent denial after four lifetime alcohol-drug convictions or three inside twenty-five years plus a serious offense spanning fatal crashes penal convictions twenty-plus points or paired five-point convictions. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=56]

FACT_ID: sec09-F10 | anchor: A04
Three-conviction drivers without a serious offense wait five extra years past alcohol revocations or two past other revocations, return only to restricted work-and-medical driving, carry interlocks five years, and lose the old seven-week impaired-driver-program shortcut so full terms run. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=57]

FACT_ID: sec09-F11 | anchor: A04
Twenty-one gates alcohol purchase and possession while zero tolerance punishes under-twenty-one driving from point-zero-two to point-zero-seven with a six-month suspension plus one hundred dollar termination and one hundred twenty-five dollar civil penalty, and repeats revoke at least a year or until twenty-one whichever lasts longer. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=57]

FACT_ID: sec09-F12 | anchor: A04
Presenting a driver license or non-driver ID card as age proof to illegally buy alcohol suspends your license or application privilege, and drinking alcohol, holding an open alcohol container, or consuming cannabis inside a vehicle on a public roadway brings up to a one-hundred-fifty-dollar fine, surcharge, crime-victim fee, and up to fifteen jail days first—rising for repeats within eighteen months—except for passengers in commerce-certified limousines or vehicles [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=57]

FACT_ID: sec09-F13 | anchor: A05
Aggravated intoxication at point-one-eight-plus costs first misdemeanants one thousand to twenty-five hundred dollars up to a year jailed and a year-plus revoked, and second-timers inside ten years face felony one thousand to five thousand dollars up to four years and eighteen months-plus revoked. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=58]

FACT_ID: sec09-F14 | anchor: A05
Intoxication at point-zero-eight-plus and drug impairment cost first misdemeanants five hundred to one thousand dollars up to a year jailed with six months-plus revoked or suspended respectively, and ten-year repeats face felony one thousand to five thousand dollars up to four years with a year-plus revoked including minimum jail or service for fresh prior intoxication. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=58]

FACT_ID: sec09-F15 | anchor: A05
Combined alcohol-drug impairment costs first misdemeanants five hundred to one thousand dollars up to a year jailed and six months-plus revoked, with ten-year felony repeats drawing one thousand to five thousand dollars up to four years and a year-plus revoked. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=58]

FACT_ID: sec09-F16 | anchor: A05
Alcohol impairment over point-zero-five to point-zero-seven costs first infractors three hundred to five hundred dollars up to fifteen days jailed and ninety days suspended, five-year repeats five hundred to seven hundred fifty up to thirty days with six months-plus revoked, and ten-year third-timers misdemeanor seven hundred fifty to one thousand five hundred up to one hundred eighty days with six months-plus revoked, while third-plus convictions inside ten years escalate further, fines exclude surcharges and victim fees, returns demand reapplication and retesting at agency discretion, and youth sanctions differ. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=58]

FACT_ID: sec09-F17 | anchor: A06
Courts must fit owned and operated vehicles with driver-paid breath interlocks at least twelve months for intoxication and vehicle-traffic alcohol felonies waivable after six installed months, assess repeaters for treatment-bound probation, charge child-under-sixteen cases as felonies worth four years under Leandra, felonize drunk conditional-license driving, and confine conditional licenses to school work and medical trips revocable for any moving breach. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=59]

FACT_ID: sec09-F18 | anchor: A06
Alcohol-drug killings and injuries invite homicide manslaughter and assault charges worth thousands and twenty-five years, suspended driving draws two hundred to one thousand mandatory dollars plus jail or probation rising to five thousand and seizure when impaired, insurance can abandon the crash leaving lawsuits and dear future coverage, and legal bills plus criminal records compound the damage. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=59]

FACT_ID: sec09-F19 | anchor: A06
Sober planning beats impaired regret through rotating designated drivers, overnight stays and sober rides, surrendered keys, cabs rideshares and transit, slow alternating drinks, and no cannabis consumption before driving. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=59]

FACT_ID: sec09-F20 | anchor: A07
Parties should center beyond alcohol with drinking halted hours before departure to let content fall, and the chapter closes quizzing impairment rank, alcohol effects, risky drugs, non-prescription caution, mixing, content factors, drink equivalence, clearance time, sole sobering method, refusal fallout, and extra-consequence awareness. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=60]
